item.g:title: DWS IQ Aegis Pilot (3 months)
item.g:description: A 3-month engagement that proves the complete local-first operational path for Aegis on your existing infrastructure or a compact edge appliance, before any DGX procurement. A bounded subset of Aegis onboarding — not a rollout. INCLUDED: one site, one control-room workflow, one deployment-mode recommendation; only the agent set that workflow requires; local execution, evidence capture, identity verification, audit logs and human kill authority stood up on existing customer hardware or a compact edge appliance; production hardware sizing derived from measured behaviour on that workload. ACCEPTANCE KPI (binary): with the uplink severed for an agreed window — (i) the piloted workflow runs to completion, (ii) the EU AI Act Article 12 record continues to be written locally, (iii) an operator can still stop a running agent. All three must pass. A pilot that does not pass has delivered a negative result, which is a valid outcome and not a defect. OUTSIDE THE CREDIT: LWM integration; any hardware; multi-site rollout; industries beyond the one piloted; custom ERP/BIM/SCADA integrations; and the separate DWS-AEGIS-IMPL-001 implementation programme. The credit is capped at €19,990, applies only against Aegis onboarding, and lapses if the customer does not proceed within 6 months.

item.g:title: DWS IQ Aegis Implementation Programme (3 phases)
item.g:description: A three-phase implementation engagement delivered alongside DWS IQ Aegis. Phase 1 Audit (2 weeks, €5,000): current state to gap analysis. Phase 2 Agent-in-production (6 weeks, €15,000): one skilled agent live and EU-compliant. Phase 3 LWM integration (8 weeks, €25,000): world-model integration so operational knowledge accumulates. ADDITIVE to Aegis onboarding and licence — this programme is NOT credited against onboarding, because Phase 3 is integration work that onboarding does not include.
